title: First steps
summary: What to do in your first minutes on Sangria Falls: install the interface, understand the screen and follow the tutorial.
sections: How to find your way in the city

title: Website panel
summary: The second screen of the game in your browser: sign in with Steam and see (and do) most of what the in-game panels do. Works with or without the interface, and is the graphical way for players without it.

title: Auto-Prestige
summary: A VIP perk that prestiges your character, your weapon, your blood and your pet on its own as soon as they reach max level.
sections: How to turn a type on and off
How to choose how far to prestige (target)

title: Blood Lineage
summary: Each type of blood you drink has its own level and prestige. The more you develop a blood, the more bonus it gives your character.

title: Classes
summary: Your class defines your weapons, your abilities, and your bonuses. There are 11 to unlock, each with 3 evolutions.
sections: How to choose your mastery and blood attributes
Summons of La Muerte, Sepulkros, and Skarn

title: Level and Prestige
summary: Take your vampire from level 1 to 90, prestige to go back to level 1 and gain a permanent buff each time. There are 20 prestiges.
sections: How to use the XP bonuses
How to hide the XP notices

title: Meditation
summary: Earn XP standing still. Inside the Meditation Chamber you get XP every minute, without fighting, paying a little Sangricoins.

title: Profile
summary: Your character's full sheet on a single screen: level, class, weapons, blood, professions, attributes, prestige bonuses and your statistics.
sections: How to see your personal rankings
How to see another player’s profile
How to turn the HUDs on and off
How to change the HUD layout

title: Pulses, Transfusions and Plasmas
summary: The endgame power: after prestige 20, each return to level 90 becomes a Pulse. Pulses become Transfusions, which yield plasmas to make your character stronger.

title: Rankings
summary: See who's ahead on the server: who has progressed the most, who has dealt the most damage and who has killed the most bosses. And find out where you stand.
sections: How to view the month’s Progression

title: Training Room
summary: Test any class for free, with its weapons, and measure your damage on a training dummy. Nothing from the test is saved.

title: Weapon Mastery
summary: Each type of weapon has its own level and prestige. The more you use a weapon, the more bonus it gives your character.

title: Pets
summary: Capture world bosses and summon one of them to fight at your side. Each pet has its own level, tier and extra attributes.
sections: How to summon and put away

title: Prisoners
summary: The Prisoner Market lets you buy and sell prisoners for Ourosangue, choosing by blood type and blood quality.
sections: How to put the prisoner in a cell

title: Sangrulhos
summary: Collectible little creatures that give your character an attribute bonus. You get eggs from the Ressonador, incubate them, equip them and fuse the duplicates.

title: Aquarium
summary: A fish tank crafted by Fishers. Installed in your castle, it produces fish on its own, even while you are offline, as long as it has food.

title: Crafts: Blacksmith, Tailor and Enchanter
summary: The three crafting professions make your gear stronger with fortification and refinement. See what each one does and how to use the panel.
sections: How to see what your piece has

title: Gathering: Miner, Fisher and Woodcutter
summary: The three gathering trades pay Ourosangue on every action and, with prestige, drop extra resources, pet souls and the components crafting uses to refine.
sections: How to earn XP and Ourosangue

title: Profession Services
summary: Pay another player to fortify or refine your gear. Or, if you're already skilled in a craft, sell that service and earn Ourosangue even while offline.
sections: How to stock up on materials

title: Professions
summary: Pick one craft trade and one gathering trade, level up by working, and earn Ourosangue, bonuses and stronger gear.

title: Dungeons
summary: Closed adventures for groups of 2 to 4 players, with rooms, bosses and a prize by mail. You enter with a key forged by Mark.
sections: How to set up the group and enter

title: Goreswine's Judgment
summary: A court for 3 to 5 players against Goreswine, the Unholy Judge. Whoever falls doesn't die: they go locked in a cell, and a free companion can set them loose. On winning, everyone gets Ourosangue and Sangricoins.

title: Group board
summary: Mark that you're up for a Dungeon, Rift, Arena or Judgment run. Whoever is forming a group at the Events Hub sees your name and can call you.
sections: How to call someone (from the Hub)

title: Illusory Arena
summary: Survive 30 waves of enemies in a sealed arena, solo or in a duo. It's worth experience and a chance at a rare prize.
sections: How to play in a duo

title: Reality Rupture
summary: Three times a day a rift opens and, on the other side, a Rupture Sovereign waits: the never-defeated version of a boss. Win in 10 minutes, solo or in a group, and earn Sangricoins and Ourosangue.
sections: What happens when you go down

title: Rift Incursions
summary: Open-world event: rifts open across the map, with portals, creatures and a gate guarded by a boss. It yields fragments for crafting dungeon keys and, with luck, a ready-made key.

title: Tower of the Immortals
summary: An endless solo challenge: waves of ever-stronger bosses, climbing a 5-floor tower. Each of the 11 classes has its own weekly ranking, and the Top 3 of each one earns Sangricoins and Ourosangue.

title: V Blood Hunt
summary: A tracker that shows which world V Blood bosses are up and how long until the others come back. Pin the ones you want to hunt and follow it all on an on-screen panel.
sections: How to pin bosses to the screen
How to use it in the hunt

title: Vampiric Schools
summary: Join one of the four schools, climb the ranks and earn an extra spell that fires along with your attack. On Sundays, your school gets double pet capture.

title: Bank
summary: The Bank is your account's wallet: it holds the server's five currencies, and almost everything in the game charges and pays straight into it.
sections: The currencies: where they come from and where they’re spent
How to deposit currencies that are in your inventory
How to withdraw, deposit and use Quitina
How to exchange Sangricoins for Ourosangue

title: Casino
summary: Betting machines that pay in Ourosangue. You pick the amount, spin the reels and the prize lands straight in the bank.
sections: How to track what you’ve played

title: Contracts
summary: Deliver materials and receive Ourosangue in the bank. You can also request materials from other players, paying for them.
sections: How to do a Balthazar contract
How to deliver on another player’s contract
How to request materials (create a contract)
How to collect the items or cancel

title: Market
summary: Buy and sell items with other players using Ourosangue. Your shop sells on its own, even while you are offline.
sections: How to follow or hide an offer

title: Online Reward
summary: Earn Sangricoins just by playing. Reach 30 minutes online in the day and get a reward every 15 minutes, bigger with each day in a row.

title: Shadow Merchant
summary: Sell leftover materials straight to the server and get Ourosangue in the bank, instantly and from anywhere.

title: Vault
summary: A room of your own in the Sangria Bank, with chests that grow up to 77 slots. You pay once.
sections: How to store and take items
How to use the Mobile Depot

title: Achievements
summary: Achievements are the server's longest quests. Each one you finish leaves a permanent bonus on your character.
sections: How to see the Thanatos cooldown

title: Castle
summary: Server helpers for looking after your castle: store your bag with one key, find any item in the chests, and get warned before the essence runs out.
sections: How to find an item in the chests
How to take items through the panel (VIP)

title: Feats
summary: Feats are medals the server hands out on its own as you play. Each medal unlocks a title and adds Fame, and Fame raises your rank.
sections: How to highlight medals on your profile
How to see another player’s Feats

title: Furniture
summary: Furniture shop to decorate your castle: bookcases, tables, thrones, lights and banners bought with Sangricoins and placed with the mouse on your castle grounds.
sections: How to place it in the castle
How to move or remove it

title: Outposts
summary: Seven outposts spread across Vardoran, each with a commander who gives you one mission per day and one per week. Helping an outpost raises your reputation there and improves what it pays.
sections: The ranks and what each one unlocks

title: Quests
summary: Quests are step-by-step tasks that teach the server, tell the story and pay XP, items and coins. Here you learn to pick up, track and finish each one.
sections: How to find a quest in the list
How to talk to an NPC
How to pin a quest to the screen
How to abandon or skip a step

title: Teleports
summary: Get back to your castle or to the City of Sangria Falls in seconds, for free. In the city, the teleport hub takes you to every hall on the server.
sections: How to use and how to remove
How to go to the city

title: The Lost Book
summary: The Lost Book is the story book of Sangria Falls. You unlock the chapters little by little, with Nyxaris, and read them whenever you want, with text and illustrations.
sections: In which transfusions the chapters arrive

title: Battle Pass
summary: A track of levels per season: you hunt V Bloods, earn pass XP, level up and claim rewards.

title: Clan
summary: The clan is the game's own. The server adds extra slots, its own invite, and a panel with members, log, and chat.

title: Mail
summary: The server's message box: talk to other players, even offline, and receive notices and gifts from the team.
sections: How to delete and see the sent ones

title: Marriage
summary: The Blood Bond joins two players: an engagement, trials together, a ceremony before A-mór, the Cupid, and a bond that grows while you play side by side. It's social and cosmetic: it gives no progression advantage.
sections: How to fulfill the Blood Vows

title: VIP
summary: VIP is the server supporter status: it gives you speed, comfort and faster progression. It's unlocked by donation.
sections: How to see the status and time left
How to use the benefits from the panel

title: Atalhos da interface
summary: Com a interface instalada, cada painel do servidor abre por uma tecla. Esc fecha o painel aberto.

title: Comandos
summary: Todo comando de jogador do servidor, por sistema. Clique em Copiar e cole no chat do jogo. Os exemplos usam valores reais: troque pelo seu.

title: Bastien
summary: “A lança tem dono por contrato. A lealdade, só por escolha.”

title: Carmesyne
summary: “Prata, julgamento e consequência sem desperdício — cada tiro é uma sentença.”

title: Despertado
summary: “Todo vampiro abre os olhos como Despertado — uma página em branco à espera do primeiro juramento.”

title: Draekhar
summary: “O saber cobra em sangue — e Draekhar sempre paga o que deve.”

title: General
summary: “Onde ele aponta a lâmina, a linha avança.”

title: LaMuerte
summary: “A morte não cobra juros: cobra tudo, de uma só vez.”

title: Mortak
summary: “Não recua. Não quebra. Não cai.”

title: Noctarin
summary: “Suas flechas encontram o alvo antes que o eco do disparo chegue.”

title: Sangrael
summary: “O sangue que derrama é o mesmo que devolve — a dádiva e a ferida têm um só nome.”

title: Sepulkros
summary: “Cada golpe alimenta o exército; cada morte, um novo servo.”

title: Skarn
summary: “A fera não empunha a força — ela É a força.”

title: Umbrellis
summary: “Você só percebe Umbrellis quando já é tarde demais.”
